shortDescription: BSEB has released Sakshamta Pariksha 5th Phase Result 2026 on 21 July 2026. Download scorecard from bsebsakshamta.com for local body teachers competency test.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has declared the Sakshamta Pariksha (Competency Test) Phase-5 Result 2026 on 21 July 2026 (around 4:00 PM).

The CBT was conducted for local body teachers and librarians of primary, middle, secondary and higher secondary schools in Bihar.

Download steps

  • Go to bsebsakshamta.com
  • Open Sakshamta-5 Score Card
  • Login and save PDF

Result was formally announced by BSEB authorities at Patna headquarters.
